config.title: 适用于 VS Code 的 OpenCode TUI
cfg.opencodePath.desc: opencode 的路径。例如：'C:/Users/ilgiz/AppData/Local/OpenCode/opencode.exe'、'opencode.cmd' 或直接 'opencode'。
cfg.serverPort.desc: opencode 服务器的端口。0 = 随机可用端口。
cfg.serverMode.desc: Server mode: 'embedded' (default) runs the TUI with its own private server; 'separate' runs a headless 'opencode serve' plus an attached TUI; 'external' attaches to a server you launched yourself (extra memory).
cfg.serverAddress.desc: Address of an externally launched 'opencode serve', e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096. Used only in 'external' mode. Stored in settings, reused across sessions.
cfg.serverPassword.desc: Password of the external server (OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD). Empty = the server needs no password.
cmd.toggleFocus.title: 切换 OpenCode 焦点
cfg.leaderChords.desc: 要拦截的前导和弦字符（例如 ["n","m","l"]）。为空则使用 tui.json 或内置默认值。
cfg.ctrlASelectAll.desc: 将Ctrl+A重定向为在输入字段中选择全部，而不是向终端发送光标到行首。
cfg.enterSendsMessage.desc: 按 Enter 发送消息，Shift+Enter 换行
cfg.orphanCleanup.startupScan.desc: 启动时扫描并清理孤立的 opencode 进程
cfg.orphanCleanup.watchdog.desc: 启用监视器以在 VS Code 关闭后清理孤立的 opencode 进程
